qualification: Proposed conservative development defaults, not user approvals or measured optimum.
stop_rules: Stop a branch after two consecutive non-improving iterations.
Stop at declared case/count/wall cap; retain partial measurements honestly.
Any extension requires a new predeclared hypothesis and budget; do not reset counters by relabeling the same branch.
comparison_objective_order: Useful complete or supported partial answer
Latency including prefill, tools, waiting and preparation
not_objectives: More source reads regardless of relevance
after_selection: Run limited held-out, continuation and context-pressure cases under a separately declared budget. Startup-parameter calibration and final lifecycle qualification are distinct test layers, not routine prompt trials.
cache_policy: Use isolated service/cache state and fixed inputs. Give a public retry journey one unique question label on first submission, then preserve exact arguments. Do not contaminate production recent-answer/negative caches.
